key_findings.statement: The current bottom-to-middle layer recognizes 532 trajectory windows from 4,575 information points and splits each into P/R/Xin measures.
key_findings.consequence: The upper layer is not empty; it is a windowed recognition/separation system.

key_findings.statement: P is mostly candidate-level stable support, R is mostly low but measurable counter-pressure, and Xin is low/decaying but ledger-retained.
key_findings.consequence: Current run shows conservative residual retention rather than strong novelty outbreak.

key_findings.statement: v35 attention mostly returns NEUTRAL, with 26 EFFECTIVE and 5 NOVELTY_DISCOVERED cases.
key_findings.consequence: Attention layer is a resource-allocation/audit layer, not an action layer.

key_findings.statement: v35H hyperedges average >7 nodes and therefore express multi-subject binding rather than binary edges.
key_findings.consequence: High-order relation indexing exists, but bottom FK remains partially inferred.

key_findings.statement: v36.2 computes action proxies, stationarity defects, and Xin_var for 120 candidate paths; delta-Xin is only fallback.
key_findings.consequence: The upper layer changes information from local window readings into path-level ledger-scored candidates.

key_findings.statement: R-band/coupler layers build pseudo-continuity candidates and triage Xin into foreground/background/deferred/thermalized/external leakage classes.
key_findings.consequence: R is not merely negative evidence; it becomes continuity-seeking structure.

key_findings.statement: v36.5 preserves Xin as minimal carriers and external readout remains read-only with blocked backwrite attempts.
key_findings.consequence: Semantic interpretation is externalized and cannot rewrite mainline.
